translation: The back mountain (後山) is the occipital bone at the back of the head. The shape of this bone differs; it may be like the character pin (品), or like the character shan (山), or like the character chuan (川), or round and pointed, or crescent-shaped, or recumbent-moon-shaped, or egg-shaped; all belong to the occipital bone. In all cases of injury, if the person has dizziness and blurred vision, tinnitus with sound, stiff neck and straight throat, difficulty in eating and drinking, restlessness in sitting and lying, and weakness of the four limbs, internally take Zheng Gu Zi Jin Dan (正骨紫金丹), externally apply Wu Long Ointment (烏龍膏), and wash with Hai Tong Pi Tang (海桐皮湯), to disperse stasis, remove numbness, and stop pain.
